encounters.weakness: Ignis-Flare (player weapon) - deals 1.5x damage to Scorch Wyrms when used in combo with geothermal flare pulses. This flare is generated when the player activates their Geomancer's 'Ignis-Flare' ability while standing near active fumaroles (which emit low-frequency pulses).

Geothermal Flare Core (pickup from previous encounter). When the player uses the Geomancer's 'Flare Pulse' ability while holding the Geothermal Flare Core, the Lava Gorgon takes 2.5x damage to its molten core.

Fissure Echo Fragment (pickup from previous encounter). When the player uses the 'Echo Chain' ability while holding the Fissure Echo Fragment, the Sovereign's lava body shatters in a cascade, causing it to take 3.5x damage over 3 seconds.
Burned Ember Shard (from player weapon) - deals 30% extra damage to fire-based attacks
Fused Lava Core (acquired from previous encounter) — when hit with a direct flame burst, it explodes, dealing 80% bonus damage and triggering a 2-second lava surge that damages nearby enemies

Burned Ember Shard (from first encounter) — if the player uses the Burned Ember Shard *and* activates the Fused Lava Core *within 3 seconds of each other*, the Maw's core destabilizes, causing it to ignite and explode.
Steel Shield (from prior encounter - pick-up at end of encounter 1)
Fireball from the Magma Spitter (used in previous encounter). The Gargoyle is vulnerable to fire-based attacks when it takes damage from a player fireball.
Ignition Core (Burnt Ember) — the boss is immune to all physical attacks but is vulnerable to fireball attacks when its core is exposed.
player weapon: 'Blasthammer of Magma' (must be equipped at start of encounter; otherwise immune to fire damage)
uses the player's pickup 'Blasthammer of Magma' — if equipped, takes 50% damage from all fire attacks
Vulnerable to attacks that use the 'Volcanic Flare Shard' (Searing Ember) — when used, applies 120% damage to its core and causes a temporary 25% reduction in health and movement speed for 4 seconds

The player's first weapon, the 'Lava Quill', which is a fire-based ink pen that emits a mild flame trail. The Geyser is weak to fire-based attacks, and the Quill causes a 2x damage effect when used on it.
The Ash Viper is vulnerable to the 'Black Magma Resin' barrier. When the resin is active, the Viper's venom is neutralized, and the player's attacks do 1.5x damage.

The Ember Core is vulnerable to the 'Cinder Sigil Fragment'. When the player activates 'Magma Echo' and uses it on the Core during its movement cycle (every 5 seconds), the Core is briefly stunned and takes double damage.
Stormcaller's Storm Pulse (Weapon) — reduces damage and causes a thunderwave knockback that disrupts the wraith's movement and weakens its ash-siphon ability.

The Obsidian Shard (pickup from previous encounter) — when the player activates the shard during a Gloom attack, the Gloom's breath attacks (which summon acid mist and blind vision) are suppressed, and it takes 25% damage for 5 seconds.

Fissure Core Fragment (pickup from encounter 2) — if the player uses the Fissure Core Fragment during the final assault, the Heart emits a crackle of thunder that destabilizes its structure, causing it to take 120% damage for 3 seconds and temporarily freeze its primary attack.
Volcanic Whistle (Player's Weapon)
Bubble Sipper (Pickup from Encounter 1)
Magma Pouch (Pickup from Encounter 2)
Chrono-Blade (Time Ripple effect - slows and shatters the Echo with a single hit)
Lava Shards (shattering the core triggers a time-stasis effect, halting enemy for 3 seconds)
Frozen Pulse (freezing the enemy halts its movement, allowing the player to exploit wave patterns and reset timing)
The paladin's holy blade when charged with celestial energy (resonance state).
Vulnerable to the Stardust Shard when used to cast 'Shield of Light'.
Vulnerable to the Stardust Shard when combined with the 'Divine Radiance' holy spell. The shard acts as a conduit to bypass defensive fields.

Chrono-Weave Fragment (a pickup from the prior encounter, unlocked after defeating the first enemy). When struck by a weapon that emits a chronal pulse (like the Chrono-Weave Fragment), Vesperis shatters and regenerates in reverse time, causing a 30% damage reduction for 3 seconds, and deals no damage until the reverse time ends.

Temporal Echo (a special ability gained from using the Chrono-Weave Fragment during the first fight). When the player activates their Chrono-Weave Fragment during combat, Nocturne momentarily reflects the player's movements.

Echo-Signature Core (a pickup from the second encounter). If the player uses the Echo-Signature Core during combat and then performs a high-damage, time-reversed attack (e.g., a chrono-slash in reverse), Aeonis collapses into a temporal paradox.

Shadowblade's blade emits a faint resonance when struck by dark energy—this triggers a 30% damage increase on the Spindle's core. The player must use their weapon to 'harmonize' with the shadow energy in the chamber to inflict critical damage.

The Drift is vulnerable to resonance frequencies generated by the player's weapon when the Shadowblade is in 'Resonance Mode.' This mode is activated by using the Fragments of the Silent Core during the fight.

The Warden is vulnerable to the 'Scream of the Fallen' ability. However, only if the player has already collected the Echo of the Dying Star and used it *during* the fight against the Necro-Solvent Drift.

Lumino-Sparks (pickup from previous encounter) - Bubbly Blip is weak to bright, glowing projectiles. The player's Lumino-Sparks (a sparkling projectile obtained in Encounter 1) burst with a gentle fizz, causing extra damage and making Blip burst into harmless confetti.

Charm-Blossom (pickup from Encounter 2) - Daisy Dribble is vulnerable to floral magic. When hit with a Charm-Blossom (a glowing, blooming flower projectile), it freezes for a second and then explodes into harmless daisies that float upward and bounce off walls.

Whisper Bloom (pickup from Encounter 2) - Echo Eel is vulnerable to enchanted floral magic. When hit with a Whisper Bloom (a bloom that plays a soft, melodic tune), it stops moving and emits a chime, then turns into harmless, glowing jellyfish that float upward and float away in harmony.
Stormcaller's Core Blast (player weapon) - dealing 1.5x damage to Electric Pulse attacks
Fractured Lightning Shard (pickup from prior encounter) - when a player uses the shard, the enemy's shadow formation flickers and takes 50% damage for 3 seconds.
Gravity Siphon (pickup from prior encounter) - if used during the boss fight, all enemy attacks are delayed by 2 seconds and the boss takes 40% damage from Core Blast hits.
Windward Blade (elemental wind property - reduces damage by 40%)
Wind + Gravity (combines Windward Blade's wind damage with the Gravitic Shard pickup — reduces damage by 50%)
Shard of the Echo (when combined with Windward Blade — triggers a resonance cascade that reduces damage by 70%)

The player's primary weapon (a fractured prism core) must be used to reflect a beam of starlight, causing the enemy to disintegrate into static. However, the prism core can only reflect light if it has been recharged through direct exposure to a celestial source (e.g., the player must stand near a broken star-film panel in the room).

The Gravitas Shard is immune to all physical attacks and resists energy damage. It only takes damage when exposed to *static resonance* — a condition that can be triggered by the Star-Film Fragment's beam.
The Void Weavers' core is vulnerable only to the *Resonance Core (Phase 1)* when it is activated in direct contact with the central star-glyph.
Tachyon Wrench (player's starting weapon) - pulses cause resonance shatter when activated in close range (1.5m radius).
Magnet Core - if placed within 2m of the drone, it freezes the drone's movement for 5 seconds. Must be placed manually via UI tool.
Gravity Stabilizer - if placed directly at the entity's core, its energy pulse stops and it begins to collapse. Player must place it manually during combat.
